flows.title: Start or schedule a meeting
steps: On your computer, go to Google Meet and click New meeting.
Choose Create a meeting for later to get a link you can share now and use afterwards, Start an instant meeting to open one straight away, or Schedule in Google Calendar to be taken to Calendar.
To schedule it in Calendar instead, open Google Calendar, click Create for a new event, add the guests and select Save, then select Send so they are notified.
To start one from Gmail, open Gmail, click Meet then New meeting in the left sidebar, and click Join now. Share it with Send invite, Copy meeting invite or Share via email.
Before your first meeting, allow the browser to use your microphone and camera; after that the microphone and camera buttons turn them on and off.

flows.title: Take attendance in a meeting
steps: Attendance tracking is available to Google Workspace Essentials, Business Plus, Enterprise Starter, Enterprise Essentials, Enterprise Standard, Enterprise Plus, Education Plus and Teaching and Learning Upgrade users.
During the meeting, click Host controls at the bottom, then toggle Attendance tracking on or off in the side panel that opens.
To arrange it beforehand, open the event in Google Calendar, click Change conference settings, tick the box next to Attendance tracking and click Save.
After the meeting the organiser is emailed a Google Sheets report naming each participant, their email, when they joined and left, and how long they were on the call.
Attendance tracking is kept in Meet only for a short time, so collect the report soon after the meeting.
